def find_products(query, max_checks=100):
    prods=[]
    i=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        prods.extend(res)
        if len(res)<page_limit:
            break
        i+=1
        if i>max_checks:
            break
    return prods

queries=['ecobee SmartCamera indoor security camera','ecobee SmartCamera','ecobee SmartCamera battery','ecobee smart camera']
for q in queries:
    prods=find_products(q)
    print('query',q,'found',len(prods))
    # filter names containing 'SmartCamera'
    filtered=[p for p in prods if 'SmartCamera' in (p.get('name') or '') or 'smartcamera' in (p.get('name') or '').lower()]
    print('  smartcamera-named',len(filtered))
    for p in filtered[:5]:
        print('   ',p.get('product_id'),p.get('name'),p.get('product_type'))

product_id=1458

# Fetch verified reviews
reviews=[]
i=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.amazon.show_product_reviews(product_id=product_id, is_verified=True, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('reviews_page',i,'count',len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    reviews.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    i+=1
print('total_reviews_verified',len(reviews))

# Fetch questions
questions=[]
i=0
while True:
    qpage=apis.amazon.show_product_questions(product_id=product_id, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    print('questions_page',i,'count',len(qpage) if qpage else 0)
    if not qpage:
        break
    questions.extend(qpage)
    if len(qpage)<20:
        break
    i+=1
print('total_questions',len(questions))

# Fetch verified answers for each question
answers=[]
for q in questions:
    qid=q['question_id']
    j=0
    while True:
        apage=apis.amazon.show_product_question_answers(question_id=qid, is_verified=True, page_index=j, page_limit=20)
        print('answers qid',qid,'page',j,'count',len(apage) if apage else 0)
        if not apage:
            break
        answers.extend(apage)
        if len(apage)<20:
            break
        j+=1
print('total_answers_verified',len(answers))

# Print small samples of battery-related texts
battery_texts=[]
for r in reviews:
    t=(r.get('text') or '')
    if 'battery' in t.lower():
        battery_texts.append(('review',r['review_id'],t))
for a in answers:
    t=(a.get('answer') or '')
    if 'battery' in t.lower():
        battery_texts.append(('answer',a['question_answer_id'],t))
print('battery_texts_count',len(battery_texts))
for item in battery_texts[:10]:
    kind,iid,text=item
    print(kind,'id',iid,'text',text[:200].replace('\n',' '))
